if: the document is a bill of supply referred to in clause (c) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 49 of the CGST Rules, 2017
the bill of supply is not an electronic bill of supply issued under the Information Technology Act, 2000
then: the bill of supply MUST carry the signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative
note: One mandatory particular of rule 49(h), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative:

Provided also that the signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative shall not be required in the case of issuance of an electronic bill of supply in accordance with the provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (21 of 2000).
